questions.question:
In the following question, select the missing number from the given series.

13, 27, 56, 115, ?

Sumitra remembers that her mother's birthday is after 13th February but before 16th February but her brother remembers that his mother's birthday is after 14th February but before 17th February. On which date Sumitra's mother's birthday will be celebrated?
questions.solution:
According to Sumitra,

Mother’s Birthday = After 13th February - Before 16th February = Either on 14th February or on 15th February

According to Sumitra’s Brother,

Mother’s Birthday = After 14th February - Before 17th February = Either on 15th February or on 16th February

So, the only common date in both statements = 15th February

Thus, Sumitra's mother's birthday will be celebrated on 15th February.

questions.question: There are five energy drinks - Red, Moto, Energy, Lion and Bull containing different range of sugar content. Moto having sugar content more than all other drinks. Energy having the sugar content only more than the Lion. Bull is not having sugar content more than the Red. Which of the following drink having the second most sugar content?
questions.solution:
The order is as per the highest amount of sugar content.

1) Moto having sugar content more than all other drinks

Moto > __ > __ > __ > __

2) Energy having the sugar content only more than the Lion

Moto > __ > __ > Energy > Lion

3) Bull is not having sugar content more than the Red

Moto > Red > Bull > Energy > Lion

Thus, the drink having the second most sugar content is Red.

questions.question:
In the following question, from the given alternative words, select the word which cannot be formed using the letters of the given word.

CALCULATING
questions.solution:
1) GAIN → C**A**LCULAT**ING** → can be formed.

2) TANING → CALCULATING → cannot be formed, as there is only one **N**.

3) TAIL → CALCU**LATI**NG → can be formed.

4) CULT → CAL**CUL**A**T**ING → can be formed.

Thus, the correct answer is ‘TANING’.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements: **

I. All LED are bulb.

II. Some bulbs are not tube light.

**Conclusions: **

I. Some tube lights are LED.

II. All LED are tube lights.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn Diagram for the given statements is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78619ff09a91245de0922e80af0a3c71ea5dbd4850965aec0c6b914e2c806358.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some tube lights are LED → false.

II. All LED are tube lights → false.

Thus, neither conclusion (I) nor conclusion (II) follows is the correct answer.
